### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] settings.mcs.yml exists and preserves the initialized identity, environment binding, language, and authoring mode.
- [ ] Every implemented production operation is represented by instructions, a skill, or a bound tool.
- [ ] Record **not applicable to this disconnected workshop** for the production-only criterion: “ERP, telemetry, and reporting connections use dedicated and verified connection references.”
- [ ] The line-health, bottleneck, improvement-option, and shift-planning prompts produce the expected synthetic records and decisions.
- [ ] Synthetic estimates are labeled as planning evidence rather than customer performance commitments.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate, user-approved step after push and validation.
